description: The MH-05 RTO is the Deputy Regional Transport Office serving the Kalyan region in the Thane district of Maharashtra. It handles vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and traffic regulation enforcement for the Kalyan-Dombivli metropolitan area and its surrounding talukas.
address: Sahyadri Nagar, Chikanghar, Near Birla School, Kalyan (West), District Thane, Maharashtra
